scheme_name: Scholarships to Students Studying in Central Government Institution like IIT, IIM, IIIT, NIT and Central Universities
other_conditions: Must be a student pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses in IIT, IIM, IIIT, NIT or Central Universities.
Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
benefits_summary: Annual reimbursement up to ₹2,00,000 for tuition, exam and other compulsory fees.
